description: This is a Java interface for the TransactionRepository, which extends CrudRepository to provide CRUD operations for Transaction entities. It includes a custom method findByAccountNumber to retrieve transactions by account number.

classes.name: TransactionRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for Transaction entities, extending Spring Data's CrudRepository to perform database operations.

methods.name: findByAccountNumber
methods.description: Custom query method to find a list of Transactions associated with a specific account number.
